annotations.title: Sing a song from finished lyrics

duration_seconds.description: song length in seconds, in steps of 15; default 60

language.description: ISO code of the lyrics language (ru, en, es, de…): the language you wrote the lyrics in. The server checks it against the lyrics and trusts the lyrics if they disagree. ru — the song lives on opensoundbox.ru, any other — on opensoundbox.com

lyrics.description: finished song lyrics with [Verse]/[Chorus] section tags on their own lines

sound_description.description: optional (required with style=custom): the sound in your own words, e.g. "doom metal with church organ, slow, heavy"

style.description: music style preset (pop, rock, hiphop, rnb, country, edm, poppunk, indie, lofi, kids, ballad, chanson, lullaby, folk, jazz); custom — your own style from sound_description (no preset is mixed in). Default auto — the server picks a style from the lyrics

title.description: optional: the song title for its page

voice.description: voice; default auto — picked from the lyrics

name: create_song
title: Sing a song from finished lyrics
